i.norm: Verifies that a freshly created {@link SummaryStatistics} (one that has not received any values) reports the same statistics as {@link StatUtils} computed over an empty array. For an empty data set every statistic is expected to be {@code NaN}, so this test pins down that "no data" behaviour.
Creates the statistics instance under test (no values added).
Each statistic of the empty SummaryStatistics must match the StatUtils result for an empty array (all of which are NaN).
